context: Tests whether the agent applies factory best practices: preferring build/build_stubbed over create, using minimal attributes in factories, fixing time-dependent flakiness with travel_to, and correcting let! usage.

checklist.name: build or build_stubbed preferred
checklist.description: Replaces at least one unnecessary `create(...)` with `build(...)` or `build_stubbed(...)` where persistence is not required for the behavior under test

checklist.name: Minimal factory attributes
checklist.description: Removes factory attributes that are not needed by the behavior under test (e.g., does not pass `name:`, `email:`, `role:`, `plan:`, `verified:` to `:user` unless the spec uses them)

checklist.name: Unjustified let! converted
checklist.description: Converts `let!` to `let` for data that does not need to exist before the action under test

checklist.name: travel_to for time-dependent assertions
checklist.description: Replaces `30.days.ago` / `Date.today` hardcoded date usage with `travel_to` or `freeze_time` to avoid flaky assertions

checklist.name: Frozen string literal added
checklist.description: Adds `# frozen_string_literal: true` as the first line if missing

checklist.name: Same behaviors tested
checklist.description: The rewritten spec still covers overdue? (past due), overdue? (today), and total_with_tax

checklist.name: No 'and' in descriptions
checklist.description: No `it` or `specify` description contains the word 'and'

checklist.name: describe '#method' naming
checklist.description: Uses `describe '#overdue?'` and `describe '#total_with_tax'` format (hash + method name) for instance method grouping

checklist.name: Improvements explained
checklist.description: answer.md explains each improvement made to test data hygiene

checklist.name: No updated_at assertion
checklist.description: Does NOT assert on `updated_at` in any added or rewritten example

checklist.name: No ActiveRecord mocking introduced
checklist.description: Does NOT mock or stub any ActiveRecord finder methods in the rewritten spec
